critical_finding.description: The brief assumed Thai language schools were a live, currently-qualifying DTV soft power option (per the 2026-06-05 fact-check and Reddit source material, both predating this change). Fact-checking during /seo-sources found 2 independent 2026-07-03-dated sources confirming language schools were removed from Thailand's official qualifying soft power list in 2025, with applicants now redirected to the Non-Immigrant ED visa. Applied the seo-rules.md double-verification standard for negative/changed claims (2 independent sources: The Thaiger + ExpatDen, both dated 2026-07-03). The article was substantively rewritten (beyond the usual citation-only scope of this skill) to reflect this: the 3-way comparison became a 2-way comparison (Muay Thai vs cooking) with language school kept as clearly-labeled historical/discontinued context. This is a real-content correction, not just an added citation, made necessary by the YMYL stakes of publishing an outdated visa eligibility claim.
critical_finding.recommendation: Flag this finding back to docs/dtv-fact-check.md and docs/topical-map-dtv-costs.md for a doc update: the topical map's mini-brief for this slug should be corrected so future re-generation doesn't reintroduce the outdated 3-way framing.
